programs.showName: Oh Humnava Tum Dena Saath Mera
programs.description: A reserved businessman who avoids romance crosses paths with an artist haunted by a bitter past, leaving the prospect of a budding romance hanging in the balance.
Withdrawn Saumya gathers the courage to reshape her existence upon meeting Jeet, a liberated nonconformist. Meanwhile, romance blossoms in Prayagraj.
Though they get off to a bad start, an aspirational Saili and an unmotivated Sachin end up getting married. Saili then tries to turn her husband into a competent person.
Dr Abhimanyu, a misogamist, finds himself getting attracted to Akshara, Kartik and Naira's daughter. Things take a tricky turn when Akshara's half-sister, Arohi, falls in love with him.
Anupamaa sacrifices her personal ambitions to dedicate her life to her family. However, she eventually decides to live on her own terms after failing to receive credit for her many trials.
Empowered Sunheri continuously shields her heavenly community against prevailing malevolence. However, her sibling Dhara constantly opposes her.
